About

Every
Medium.

I'm Youssef Ali — a media practitioner with a passion for the full craft of visual storytelling.

My path started with sound and radio, moved through cinema and the frame, and settled — for now — on editing as my sharpest tool.

My goal is simple: deliver something I'm proud to add to my reel, and that you're proud to share with the world.
